meaning:
§ Pi-beseth = "mouth of loathing"
a town of lower Egypt located on the west bank of the Pelusiac branch of the Nile about 40 miles from Memphis
1a) same as 'Bubastis' named after the goddess of the same name

elsewhere.note: The young men of Aven and of Pibeseth will fall by the sword. They will go into captivity.
